title: Expect jam-free drive on upgraded Jln Genting Kelang | The Star
text:
Expect jam-free drive on upgraded Jln Genting Kelang | The Star
MOTORISTS plying Jalan Genting Kelang in Kuala Lumpur can look forward to a more jam-free route as the road has been upgraded by Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL).
Federal Territories Minister Datuk Seri Tengku Adnan Tengku Mansor said the upgrading of the road signified the end of the second phase of the project.
